This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
Street flood sensors have not recorded any above-curb flood events near 1 East 161st Street, Bronx, within the last 3 years [floodnet].

This address sits outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint (NYC OEM) [sandy_inundation]. This address sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970083F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR) [dep_moderate_2050]. No Hurricane Ida (Sept 2021) high-water marks were surveyed within 800 m of this address. Nearest USGS-surveyed mark: Seaman Ave., between Dyckman St. and Riverside Dr., Inwood, Manhattan (4140 m away) [ida_hwm].

**Live Observer.**
Four NYC 311 flood-related complaints were filed within 200 m of this location in the last 5 years. The most common descriptor was Catch Basin Clogged/Flooding (Use Comments) [nyc311].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
